scope: Real PODS browser UI and server with simulated OAuth/providers/preparation on loopback. Notes artifact, runner, save and persistence are real local execution. Not native Google or GitHub provider evidence.
observedBeforeFix: During the real optimized Angular preparation, an expired Google connection caused the first click to fail with 401. A second click was needed to reconnect and resume.

checks.name: Expired Google preparation reconnects on first click and resumes the exact new draft
Cancel reconnect preserves repository, folder and selected Google provider despite older build history
Repository validation error is displayed without automatic retry
Repeated Google preparation expiration stops after one automatic recovery
Expired GitHub launch reconnects on first click and automatically opens the exact product
Repeated GitHub launch expiration stops after one automatic recovery
Cancelling first preparation preserves and expands a nonempty folder with no build history

reproduce: Run node scripts/browser-fixture.mjs and open http://127.0.0.1:19888/develop or /launch/field-notes. Complete a simulated provider authorization first.

Leave the page showing Connected. POST http://127.0.0.1:19888/fixture/expire-connections from the test controller, then click Prepare/Open once. Complete the simulated authorization and verify automatic continuation.
Use ?repeat=1 on that fixture-only POST to expire every action. Verify one authorization return then a visible error, with no redirect loop or new job. POST without repeat clears this mode.
Read /fixture/report to compare accepted/rejected submission counts and created jobs. Cancellation and invalid repository submissions must not create work.
fixtureRepair: Enabled the real notes example API in the loopback product proxy so browser save/read can be verified. Fixture process was restarted between developer and launch phases; reports are retained separately.
harnessNotes: An AX disclosure button was not found by a DOM button-role selector; using its current AX control expanded it. A DOM input-value evaluation timed out; the current AX tree and server job metadata verified the exact draft instead.
